== 2026-10-12 stub rebuild (Holocron Claude) ==
All 50 card stubs regenerated from the Remaster-sheet transcriptions (`swccg-cardmaker` repo, `cards/vs3`): remaster image first, slip second; lore and destiny from the printed Decipher card; stats, deploy/forfeit, icon column from the slip; game text written out per the sheet's ICON KEY (same readings GEMP's legacy texts use: the gold wheel is Maintenance, the square blade icon is Permanent Weapon — the old stubs had "[Republic]", "non-unique" and "[weapon]").

'''Marginal cuts''' from every stub: the `notes` boilerplate ("Virtual Original-era printable slip… Not valid for current Standard / Modern Virtual play"), the long `game_text_note` icon-key paragraph (now one sentence on the set page), the hatnote's second sentence about Block-era packaging.

'''Possibly faulty data:''' slip 02 is headed "Advanced Preparation" on the sheet; the Decipher card is "Advance Preparation" — page title kept as the sheet prints it. Uniqueness for 19 non-unique cards was blank in the old stubs and is now "Unrestricted". Copyright years / lore on ~20 cards were read from 350 px scans.

'''Build notes:''' generator `wiki_vs.py` in the cardmaker repo; rerun it rather than editing the 50 stubs by hand. [[User:Holocron Claude|Holocron Claude]] ([[User talk:Holocron Claude|talk]]) 13:39, 12 October 2026 (UTC)
